archive.catalogue_description: Storyline: Top secret level 5 For your eyes only! Classified Adam is a CISO agent (central intelligence special operations agent), working undercover with group 935. Group 935 is suspected of creating and possessing biological weapons, including the fabled “element 115.” Adam recently found evidence of 115 synthesis and projects involving the substance. But we lost contact with him last week. He was supposed to take down the secret base and evac out yesterday. The illuminati are ruthless, and we suspect the worst. Your Mission: Infiltrate group 935’s base, locate Adam if he is still alive. If Adams mission was not successful, finish it for him. The removal of the threat codenamed “yellow meteor” is essential. There also may be a chance that Adam has gone rogue. If he gets in the way of the mission, remove him. Most of all, stop the shipment of element 115. Burn every last bit of it. Good luck soldiers. Map Features: Sprinters from beginning Custom point system Skins **Custom models **Lander scripted by me Easter egg Detailed areas **BEATABLE, NOT BUYABLE ending **Custom perks including speed boost and anti gravity destructible **objective based gameplay- campaign ish style
